title: How Reliable Is Individualized Functional-Network Attribution in Resting-State fMRI Cognitive Prediction in ADNI?
abstract: arXiv:2610.37472v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Individualized attribution estimates which functional networks drive a model prediction for a given subject and is often proposed as an interpretable resting-state fMRI (rs-fMRI) biomarker, but its test-retest reliability is rarely quantified. We evaluate per-subject network-ablation attribution for a frozen resting-state functional connectivity (FC) predictor (Schaefer-200 FC predicting MMSE/ADAS-Cog13) trained on N=875 subjects from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI), using, and (iii) a subject-level permutation null. Split-half reliability is near-ceiling (Spearman p=0.948/0.950) but drops on scan-rescan (p=0.609/0.616). Under the mismatched-subject null, correlations remain substantial (p~0.46-0.47), indicating strong population-shared structure, yet matched pairs exceed this null (z~6.6-6.9, p<=10-4). Thus, in ADNI, individualized network attribution contains a modest but non-zero person-specific component atop

translated_title: 在ADNI静息态fMRI认知预测中，个体化功能网络归因的可靠性如何？
translated_abstract: 个体化归因用于评估哪些功能网络驱动了模型对特定受试者的预测，并常被提议作为一种可解释的静息态fMRI（rs-fMRI）生物标志物，但其重测信度很少被量化。我们评估了针对冻结的静息态功能连接（FC）预测器的逐受试者网络消融归因（Schaefer-200 FC 预测 MMSE/ADAS-Cog13），该预测器在来自阿尔茨海默病神经影像学倡议（ADNI）的 N=875 名受试者上训练，并使用了 受试者级别的置换零假设。分半信度接近上限（Spearman ρ=0.948/0.950），但在扫描-重扫描时有所下降（ρ=0.609/0.616）。在不匹配受试者的零假设下，相关性仍然很大（ρ~0.46-0.47），表明存在强烈的群体共享结构，但匹配对显著超过了这一零假设（z~6.6-6.9，p≤10⁻⁴）。因此，在 ADNI 中，个体化网络归因在群体共享结构之上包含一个适度但非零的个体特异性成分。
tldr: 该研究首次系统量化了ADNI静息态fMRI认知预测中个体化功能网络归因的信度，发现其分半信度接近上限但重测信度中等，且归因结果虽以群体共享结构为主，仍包含适度但非零的个体特异性成分。
en_tdlr: This study systematically quantifies the reliability of individualized functional-network attribution in ADNI resting-state fMRI cognitive prediction, showing that while attribution is dominated by population-shared structure, it retains a modest yet non-zero person-specific component.
